description: Explain insurance coverage and expected costs in plain English.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: 'What will my MRI cost?' deserves a real answer, and the deductible-to-coinsurance-to-OOP-max math is genuinely useful. But the monetization is three maybes (employer add-on, broker white-label, HSA affiliate), and CMS price-transparency rules are pushing this toward free. A feature of benefits navigators, not a company.
Cost translator renders 4-step deductible/coinsurance/OOP math; re-translate OK, zero errors.

notes.change: Added 3-facility price comparison (freestanding 1.0x / hospital 2.6x / cash-pay 0.8x) with your-cost bars; sharpened hero.
